products.name: Chikmagalur Peaberry, 250g
products.description: Washed peaberry from a single estate off the Baba Budangiri slopes. Bright acidity, black-tea finish. Roasted Thursdays.

products.name: Malabar Monsoon, 250g
products.description: Sixteen weeks of monsoon-wind curing turns this arabica mellow and loamy. The coffee for people who think they don't like acidity.

products.name: Brewer's Dozen Espresso Blend, 100g
products.description: House espresso: 70% robusta from Coorg for crema that hangs around, 30% chikmagalur arabica so you can still taste the coffee.

products.name: Swiss Water Decaf, 250g
products.description: Chemical-free decaffeination that keeps the body intact. For the 8pm crowd who refuse to compromise.

products.name: Kadai Channi Filter, brass
products.description: Traditional South Indian filter in solid brass, machined in Bengaluru. The 200ml size two people fight over.

products.name: Channi Dripper, ceramic
products.description: Our pour-over cone with a widened rib for faster drawdown on the 1:16 brews. Dishwasher-safe glaze.

products.name: 53mm Tamper, stainless
products.description: 585g of machined 304 steel with a walnut handle. Calibrated flat base; no bells, no curve.

products.name: Brew Scale, 0.1g
products.description: 0.1g resolution, 2kg max, USB-C. The auto-timer starts the moment the water does.

products.name: A2 Gir Cow Ghee, 500ml
products.description: Bilona-churned from free-grazing Gir herds in Kutch. Grainy at room temperature, the way it should be.

products.name: Kaatuvellum Palm Jaggery, 350g
products.description: Unfiltered palmyra jaggery from the Tamil Nadu west coast. Caramel depth white sugar pretends to have.

products.name: Filter Kaapi Spice Box, 6 tins
products.description: Cardamom, dry ginger, pepper, cinnamon, clove, nutmeg — pre-measured to doctor 40 cups of kaapi each.
